item.title: Kiyan Foroughi charts a cosmic journey of self on ‘inner light. OUTER SPACE.’

OUTER SPACE. — a sweeping, cinematic concept record that blends neo-soul, conscious hip-hop, jazz, and trip-hop into a story about remembering who you are. item.title: It's 'DEADLINE' day: BLACKPINK unveil banger 3rd EP, go 'BIG' with cinematic music video
item.description: The queens are back — and they’re moving with purpose. BLACKPINK have officially returned as a full group with their third mini album, DEADLINE. Marking their first new release together in three years and five months, the five-track project signals a new chapter for the global icons following last year’s massive world tour. As the title suggests, DEADLINE captures what the group describe as their “most irreversible and defining moments,” while spotlighting BLACKPINK at their brightest right now.

item.title: "This one hurts": Rolling Loud Australia 2026 cancelled a week before showtime
item.description: Hip-hop fans Down Under are taking a major L this week. Rolling Loud Australia 2026, which was set to mark the festival’s long-awaited return since 2019, has officially been cancelled just days before it was due to take place. The festival was slated for 7 March at Sydney’s Centennial Park before heading to Melbourne’s Flemington Racecourse on 8 March. item.title: BTS’ Jungkook addresses idol pressures, agency restrictions & death threats in deleted Weverse livestream
item.description: In a now-deleted livestream, Jungkook of BTS has addressed the stress and pressures of being a widely sought-after K-pop icon, who's constantly in the limelight. Taking place on 26 February, the livestream captured a more vulnerable side of the worldwide pop star as he broke down his experience of being part of one of the most prominent K-pop outfits in the world over the last decade. item.title: BLACKPINK's ROSÉ makes history as first K-pop artist to win at BRIT Awards with 'APT.'
item.description: ROSÉ became the first K-pop artist to win a trophy at the BRIT Awards, taking home Best International Song for her global smash ‘APT.’ with Bruno Mars. Held at Co-op Live in Manchester, the UK’s biggest night in music saw the BLACKPINK member triumph in a stacked category that included songs by Taylor Swift, Sabrina Carpenter, and Alex Warren, alongside 11 other major international hits. item.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER announce 8th mini album '7th Year: A Moment of Stillness in the Thorns'
item.description: TOMORROW X TOGETHER are gearing up for their next chapter. On 13 April, the five-member group — Soobin, Yeonjun, Beomgyu, Taehyun, and Hueningkai — will release their 8th mini album, 7TH YEAR: A Moment of Stillness in the Thorns. The announcement was shared via Weverse, marking their first group release since all members renewed their contracts with BIGHIT MUSIC in August. item.title: Day Zero Festival to debut in Bali this April with John Summit, Jamie Jones, Bonobo, Vintage Culture & more
item.description: Day Zero Festival has unveiled the full lineup for its Bali debut, with John Summit, Jamie Jones, Bonobo, Vintage Culture, Damian Lazarus and more set to headline the week-long ritual taking place from 14 – 19 April across the island. The centrepiece lands on 17 April at Garuda Wisnu Kencana Cultural Park, where the festival’s iconic sunset-to-sunrise ceremony will unfold against one of Bali’s most dramatic backdrops.
